generated_for: Simon Jones Designs official named standup catalog

brands.name: Simon Jones Designs
brands.location_label: Byron Bay, New South Wales, Australia
brands.short_description: Family-run Byron Bay label handcrafting stock and custom shortboards and mid-lengths since 1983.

models.name: 2-Track
models.description: The 2-Track is closely related to the Tracks Twinny, with low nose entry rocker and an overall foil and outline tuned for power and hold. A shortboard built for confident rail work in quality waves.

models.name: Au Go Go
models.description: The Au Go Go started as a step-up Tracks Twinny and was later renamed before its Stab Electric Acid Test appearance. A high-performance twin for surfers who want extra drive in solid surf.

models.name: Calypte
models.description: The Calypte is a high-performance twin built for speed, control, and progression. With a refined outline, subtle wing, and double stringer construction, it handles everything from fast reef waves to everyday conditions.

models.name: Dylan
models.description: The Dylan is a twin-fin longboard built for glide, paddle power, and speed across all conditions. With a fast outline and added tail rocker, it trims easily yet still turns and connects sections when needed.

models.name: Fiji
models.description: The Fiji is Simon Jones Designs' most ridden model — a versatile all-rounder defined by its triple stringer and four deep channels. Built for powerful waves but adaptable across a wide size range.

models.name: Keel
models.description: The classic Keel is a cruisey twin rooted in 1960s San Diego design. With a wide outline, even foam, and swallow tail hold, it offers smooth speed, flow, and projection through long, drawn-out turns.

models.name: LBOH
models.description: The Little Board of Happiness is a compact small-wave twin built for speed, pocket surfing, and tight sections. With plenty of foam and a signature moon tail, it feels fast, stable, and surprisingly holdy for its size.

models.name: Little Wing
models.description: The Little Wing is a lively twin with low entry rocker, early glide, and a winged tail for tight, controlled turns. Fast and responsive, it can be ridden short for performance or longer for smooth, cruisey flow.

models.name: Massive
models.description: The Massive was designed for small-day cruising and wide-line paddling on bigger swells. With low entry rocker, deep channels, and plenty of foam, it trims easily, holds strong when it counts, and carries speed across a wide range of conditions.

models.name: Remote Location
models.description: The Remote Location is a down-the-line step-up built for serious surf. With a refined plan shape, controlled rocker, and unique nose concave, it offers hold, confidence, and flow in hollow, powerful waves.

models.name: Tracks Twinny
models.description: The baseboard from which all Simon Jones twinnies evolved. Born from a 5'8" swallow-tail single fin made for a Tracks Magazine board test, the Tracks Twinny delivers balanced twin feel with speed, flow, and everyday versatility.

models.name: Twin Pin
models.description: The Twin Pin is a versatile all-round twin built for speed, flow, and everyday conditions. With simple contours and a forgiving outline, it blends the drive of the Fiji with added looseness and adaptability in smaller or imperfect waves.
